evidence: Carries the Consensus label and adds BIP-119 script execution logic in src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: This PR implements BIP-119 (OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY) consensus rules, which validation guidelines designate as high priority to evaluate and review for correctness regardless of whether or when mainnet activation occurs. Per the author, it implements template hash verification and caches required hashes in transaction precomputation data, resolving the problem where developers 'cannot test BIP-119 transaction templates against Bitcoin Core\'s codebase without custom out-of-tree builds.' Deliberate architectural decision and thorough review of soft-fork logic are critical to unblock covenant protocol evaluation.
